# Los Angeles ADL

> The Anti-Defamation League's Los Angeles regional office combats antisemitism, hate crimes, and discrimination through advocacy, education, and community partnerships.

Los Angeles ADL serves the greater Los Angeles area and surrounding Southern California counties (Riverside, San Bernardino, Kern County) with programs focused on fighting hate crimes, challenging bias, disrupting online harassment, and combating extremism. The organization provides incident reporting, educational resources, and policy advocacy to protect civil rights and promote community safety.

## Key Topics

- Antisemitism

## Core Mission & Programs

- [Fight Antisemitism](https://la.adl.org/what-we-do/fight-antisemitism): ADL's antisemitism fighting programs including incident audits and education.
- [Combat Extremism](https://la.adl.org/what-we-do/combat-extremism): ADL's extremism monitoring and disruption efforts using H.E.A.T. Map and databases.
- [Challenge Bias](https://la.adl.org/what-we-do/challenge-bias): ADL's bias challenge programs addressing discrimination and hate prevention.
- [Disrupt Online Hate and Harassment](https://la.adl.org/what-we-do/disrupt-online-hate-harassment): ADL's online hate prevention and platform accountability initiatives.

## News & Reports

- [Hate Crimes Targeting Jews Soar 91% from the Previous Year](https://la.adl.org/resources/press-release/hate-crimes-targeting-jews-soar-91-previous-year): Press release reporting 91% increase in hate crimes targeting Jews in LA County.
- [ADL Says Antisemitism on the Rise Statewide in California](https://la.adl.org/adl-says-antisemitism-on-the-rise-statewide-in-california): ADL report on rising antisemitism trends across California based on incident audits.
- [Education Dept. to Investigate USC's Handling of Antisemitic Harassment Against Rose Ritch](https://la.adl.org/education-dept-to-investigate-uscs-handling-of-antisemitic-harassment-against-rose-ritch): News coverage of Education Department investigation into USC antisemitic harassment.
- [ADL Los Angeles Welcomes New Senior Regional Director, David Englin](https://la.adl.org/resources/press-release/adl-los-angeles-welcomes-new-senior-regional-director-david-englin): Press release announcing David Englin as new ADL Los Angeles senior director.
- [Lawmakers push for more transparency from social media companies](https://la.adl.org/lawmakers-push-for-more-transparency-from-social-media-companies): News coverage of lawmakers' push for social media platform transparency.
- [Culver City Councilmember on Homelessness: "Marching People Off to Concentration Camps in Palmdale Is Not a Solution"](https://la.adl.org/culver-city-councilmember-on-homelessness-marching-people-off-to-concentration-camps-in-palmdale-is-not-a-solution): ADL response to controversial concentration camp comparison by Culver City councilmember.
